implementedDecision: Normalize reusable intents and bind only actions the AXM host can prove. Keep beginner/core commands visible by default; retain advanced and specialist actions behind one explicit toggle.
nativeBoundary: The workbook is research evidence, not authority to issue shortcuts to Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, video editors, Procreate, or other native hosts. Native execution requires a separately installed, capability-matched adapter and approval route.
